text: dsh-session-context-menu 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话操作插件，通过客户端模块在会话行菜单和侧边栏会话附件位置加入操作。用户可以置顶会话、标记未读、在 Finder 中显示工作目录、复制工作目录或会话 ID、复制会话深度链接，以及在新窗口打开会话；置顶和未读标记会显示在会话行旁。置顶与未读状态保存在本机 JSON 文件中，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-session-context-menu adds actions to DSH Web session rows: pin or mark unread, reveal a workspace in Finder, copy its path or session ID, copy a deep link, and open a session in a new window. Pin and unread state is stored locally. No API key or external account is needed.
想给 DSH 会话置顶并标记哪些还没读。
I want quick menu actions to copy a session link or ID.
怎么从会话列表直接打开对应的工作目录？
dsh-session-context-menu 的功能「会话状态标记」：在会话行菜单中切换置顶或未读状态，并在会话行旁显示对应标记；状态通过 Host 状态服务保存到本机 JSON 文件。
dsh-session-context-menu 的功能「会话快捷操作」：会话菜单可在 Finder 中显示工作目录、复制工作目录或会话 ID、复制会话深度链接，以及在新窗口打开会话。

dsh-session-context-menu README · dsh-session-context-menu：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Lifecycle-safe, Codex-style Session context actions for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It extends the official Session-row registry and accessory Slot; it does not patch installed packages, inspect React Fiber, query private DOM, or replace the Workspace browser.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Actions：- Pin or unpin a chat. Pinned rows lead while preserving their existing relative order.
- Mark a chat read or unread, with an accessible row indicator.
- Show the Workspace directory with DSH's native path opener.
- Copy the working directory, Session id, or a browser deep link.
- Open the deep link in a new browser window.
- Use DSH's built-in Rename, Fork, and Archive actions in the same menu.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Actions：The ellipsis button, native right click, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd>, and the Menu key all open one shared action model. Deep links use `?session=<id>` and are resolved only after the Session list contains that id.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Compatibility：| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| `0.1.0-rc.6` | Unsupported: no official Session-row extension point |
| `0.1.0-rc.7` | Unsupported without the upstream `sessionRows` change |
| Upstream with `ctx.sessionRows` and `sidebar.workspaces.session.accessory` | Supported |

The plugin intentionally refuses to load when the required service is absent. This avoids silently falling back to private UI attachment.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Install：After the compatible upstream release and this repository's first public release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Harzva/dsh-session-context-menu
```

For isolated local development:

```sh
DSH_HOME=/path/to/throwaway-dsh-home dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-context-menu
DSH_HOME=/path/to/throwaway-dsh-home dsh web
```

dsh-session-context-menu README · Install：Do not point development commands at a production profile. Removing the dependency cleanly removes the Host route, registry actions, accessory component, and deep-link listener:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-context-menu
```

dsh-session-context-menu README · Persistence and privacy：Pin/read state is stored as boolean-only JSON under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-session-context-menu/state.json`, or under an explicit `storeRoot` supplied in the Cordis config entry. Writes are serialized and atomically renamed; files are created mode `0600`. Session transcripts, prompts, Workspace paths, credentials, and clipboard contents are never persisted by this plugin.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Persistence and privacy：The Host exposes one same-origin, no-store JSON route at `/dsh-session-context-menu/state`. Request bodies are bounded to 32 KiB and accept only a bounded Session id plus boolean `pinned`/`unread` fields. Native path opening uses DSH's existing `ctx.workspaces.openPath()` capability instead of adding another filesystem endpoint.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Development：```sh
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

The test suite covers state validation, concurrent atomic persistence, Cordis route disposal, client contribution registration, priority, deep-link opening, clipboard actions, native path delegation, and client cleanup. Release validation additionally uses a throwaway DSH profile for install, cold-start, light/dark visual checks, right-click/keyboard interaction, unload, and rollback.

dsh-session-context-menu README · Marketplace submission：The [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog currently requires an installable `dsh.bundle`, the `dsh-plugin` topic, a repository at least one day old, and at least ten commits. This repository keeps those requirements in its release checklist; the catalog entry is submitted only after the upstream extension ships and the isolated composition passes.
